outlook.statement: With the Joint Venture in soft ferrites and textile capacity expansion in Tirupur, the Company anticipates a 15–20% increase in turnover over the next 12–18 months. Improved cost controls and value-added products are expected to yield better profit margins, leading to a notable improvement in EBITDA.

The Economic Survey 2025-26 projects real GDP growth of 6.8–7.2% for FY 2026-27. For the Company, the operating environment in FY 2025-26 was markedly better on the demand side than the previous year. Lower inflation, tax relief and GST rationalisation revived discretionary consumption, directly benefiting the automotive, consumer electronics and textile and apparel sectors that we serve. At the same time, elevated US tariffs for most of the year created uncertainty for export-oriented garment customers, and geopolitical developments, including the conflict in West Asia towards the end of the fiscal year, introduced fresh risks to supply chains, commodity prices and freight costs.

Broad-based revival in private consumption aided by GST 2.0, income tax relief and lower interest rates bodes well for sustained demand in automotive, electronics and textile and apparel segments. Record automobile volumes, rising EV penetration and government push to build domestic electronics component ecosystem are structural tailwinds for ferrite magnet division. FTAs with key markets and shift towards branded apparel support medium-term demand for garment trims.

Company continues to evaluate capacity expansion with increased infrastructure and facilities in trims segment for scalability and ramp-up of incremental machinery and manpower. Joint venture with PREMO S.L. positions soft ferrite magnet division to participate in higher value-added applications including electric mobility and electronics.

Focus on liquidity management through cost-reduction initiatives and working capital optimisation with stated aim of becoming a net debt-free company. Restructuring customer and product portfolio to grow business profitably.
